svg.title: C13-M04-F3: Clean source - manage only from something cleaner
svg.desc: A privileged-access workstation managing Tier 0 is allowed; an ordinary laptop managing Tier 0 is not, with the clean-source rule stated.
svg.text: C13-M04-F3 Clean source - manage only from something cleaner
ordinary laptop (mail, web) --manages--> Tier 0 (DCs) NOT OK
rule: the controlling system must be >= the trust of what it controls
Figure C13-M04-F3. The clean-source principle: you cannot securely manage Tier 0
from a machine exposed to commodity attacks.
